title.zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Opus 5，性能接近 Fable 5 且价格减半
title.en: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5, which it says comes close to Fable 5 performance at half the price; it is the new default model on Claude Max

summary.zh: Claude Opus 5 成为 Claude Max 的默认模型。

title.zh: Meta、微软、OpenAI 等签署支持开放权重 AI 模型的公开信
title.en: Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, and others sign a letter defending open-weight AI models; Jensen Huang, in his first X post, says open models strengthen cybersecurity

summary.zh: Jensen Huang 首次发文称开放模型有助于加强网络安全。

title.zh: 消息称 Anduril 正在洽谈新一轮融资，估值或达 1000 亿美元
title.en: Sources: Anduril is in talks with investors for a new funding round that could see it valued at around $100B; the company raised $5B at a $61B valuation in May

summary.zh: 该公司在 5 月份以 610 亿美元估值筹集了 50 亿美元。

title.zh: Meta 更新 Meta AI，新增 Muse Spark 1.1 驱动的代理功能
title.en: Meta updates Meta AI with Muse Spark 1.1-powered agentic capabilities, connecting to Gmail and Google Calendar to perform tasks like creating daily updates

summary.zh: 新功能可连接 Gmail 和 Google Calendar 执行任务，如创建每日更新。

title.zh: 德里高等法院裁定 OpenAI 使用 ANI 内容训练 ChatGPT 不构成版权侵权
title.en: Delhi High Court rules OpenAI's use of ANI content to train ChatGPT wasn't copyright infringement as the news agency didn't show ChatGPT reproduced its reports

summary.zh: 法院认为新闻机构未能证明 ChatGPT 复制了其报道。

title.zh: 中国推动追赶美国 AI 芯片，副总理警告抵制本地芯片者为叛徒
title.en: A look at China's push to catch up with US AI chips; sources: its Vice Premier warned AI companies that anyone who resisted using local chips was a traitor

title.zh: Midjourney 收购 AI 占星应用 Co-Star，计划推出独立图像生成应用
title.en: Midjourney bought astrology app Co-Star, which uses AI to offer personalized advice, in the spring and is building its first standalone image-generation app

title.zh: Cognition 收购 AI 助手 Poke 的开发公司，交易估值“低九位数”
title.en: Cognition acquires the makers of Poke, an AI assistant that users can access via messaging services, in a deal valuing Poke's parent in the “low nine figures”

title.zh: 消息称 Prentis 正在洽谈以 10 亿美元估值筹集 1 亿美元
title.en: Sources: Prentis, which develops computer use models and is co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Marc Pincus, is in talks to raise $100M at a $1B valuation

summary.zh: Prentis 专注于开发计算机使用模型，由 Reid Hoffman 和 Marc Pincus 联合创立。

title.zh: Paper 完成 3400 万美元 A 轮融资，由 Accel 和 ICONIQ 领投
title.en: Paper, which allows designers to connect directly with production code and the AI agents that create it, raised a $34M Series A led by Accel and ICONIQ

summary.zh: Paper 允许设计师直接连接生产代码和 AI 代理。

title.zh: 消息称 Waymo 正在考虑退出与 Uber 的合作
title.en: Sources: Waymo is exploring exiting its Uber partnership, with their relationship souring amid an intense lobbying battle over the future of robotaxis

summary.zh: 双方关系因围绕机器人出租车未来的激烈游说战而恶化。

title.zh: Mobileye 创始人兼 CEO Amnon Shashua 计划卸任
title.en: Mobileye founder and CEO Amnon Shashua plans to step down after nearly three decades, as the company pushes into robotaxis and humanoid robots

summary.zh: 在公司推进机器人出租车和人形机器人领域的背景下，他结束了近三十年的领导生涯。

title.zh: 韩国企业借助 AI 资金加大对美投资
title.en: Flush with AI cash, South Korean groups are making their biggest US investment push in years, with their Q1 US foreign direct investment up 100%+ YoY to $10.2B

summary.zh: 韩国企业在第一季度对美直接投资同比增长超 100%，达到 102 亿美元，创下近年来最大投资力度。
